stories.delivered_paragraph: Warner Bros. sued Amazon Tuesday, alleging it tried to “pirate away” employees and improperly interfered with their contracts and prospective business relationships. The complaint also accuses Amazon of breach of contract and unfair competition, putting a workplace-recruitment dispute between major entertainment companies into court and potentially exposing their hiring practices.

stories.delivered_paragraph: Monday.com is the latest large tech company to cite artificial intelligence as a factor in layoffs, TechCrunch reported in a running tally that now includes 20 companies this year. The list underscores how employers are increasingly linking job cuts to AI-driven changes in staffing and operations, though the stated role of AI can vary widely from company to company.

stories.delivered_paragraph: More than 300,000 people fled wildfires in France and Spain as high temperatures and strong winds frustrated firefighters; France ordered another 55,000 evacuations in Gironde and Landes. Spain declared a state of emergency, and València authorities confirmed one death after a man in his 70s was found in a car; shifting weather helped near Madrid, but Bordeaux remains threatened.

stories.delivered_paragraph: Marvel Studios cast David Jonsson as T’Challa’s adult son and new Black Panther in “Black Panther 3,” which Ryan Coogler will direct for release on Dec. 15, 2028. The character, introduced as a child in “Wakanda Forever,” will come of age eyeing Wakanda’s crown, extending the franchise beyond Chadwick Boseman’s T’Challa as Letitia Wright and Winston Duke return.

stories.delivered_paragraph: WNBA commissioner Cathy Engelbert declined at All-Star Weekend in Chicago to say whether she expects to remain in her job for the 2027 season. Engelbert said she would continue executing the league’s strategy during “hypergrowth,” but ESPN reported more than 20 owners, executives, players and insiders expressed broad doubts that she is suited to lead the league through its current demands.

stories.delivered_paragraph: Inmates at New Bell prison in Cameroon are recording songs and making music videos through the jail’s own record label, turning some prisoners into small-scale stars beyond its walls. The unusual project creates a creative outlet inside a prison better known for its harsh reputation, while giving prisoners a way to be heard by audiences outside the institution.

stories.delivered_paragraph: LeBron James’s decision to join the Philadelphia 76ers was not settled until early Friday morning, according to his agent, Rich Paul, who called the process an “emotional roller coaster.” The late resolution ends uncertainty around one of basketball’s biggest names and shifts attention to how the move will reshape the 76ers’ plans for the coming NBA season.
